claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Pentylenetetrazol is a GABA(A) receptor antagonist convulsant that at 2.5 uM is unlikely to kill cancer cells directly; any observed antiproliferative effect would most plausibly reflect weak, non-selective cytotoxicity rather than a specific oncogenic mechanism.
